How this is calculated: Standard P&L sign convention — Revenue accounts (GL 5xxx) are stored as positive, COGS (GL 6xxx) and Operating Expenses (GL 7xxx+) as negative, in the source file. Figures below use the signed amount directly: Gross Profit = Revenue + COGS, Net Profit = Gross Profit + Operating Expenses (COGS/Opex being negative, this subtracts them). All figures respect the filters and month range above.

Note on budget: the Budget figure in the source file repeats on every transaction row for a GL account. This dashboard takes it once per GL (not summed per row) — the correct annual budget for that account — and prorates it to the selected month range when enabled. Budget and Actual are both shown as positive magnitudes (revenue accounts store a negative budget in the source file) so Variance = Budget − Actual is comparable and sums correctly across every account.
